slug: 2025-05-05 Morocco boosts digital ID for government services (DGSN–Ministry partnership)

facts.fact: The DGSN and the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform signed a deal to let all government entities digitise services accessed through the national biometric digital ID, with a legal and organisational blueprint for identity verification through a trusted third-party service.

note: as_of uses the published date (2025-05-05) as the document gives no event date.
